searchText: We are seeing at least 3 different chains on Ropsten now, etherscan is on one chain while our nodes seem to be on a mix of two _other_ chains. Anyone else seeing anything similar? All our nodes are on 1.10.8 havent quite figured out why our nodes are on 2 different chains yet. Correction, our nodes weren't on 2 different chains, just some of them got stuck at an older block on the same chain. FWIW etherscan seems to have reorged to the same chain as us now and so we're just trying to get our stuck nodes unstuck (lots of bad nodes on ropsten network so they are hitting lots of bad peers) Could you post some checkpoints for the good chain (executable in 1.10.8) so we know which blocks to look for **AllCoreDevs in ~16.5h (14:00 UTC Sept 3)** Agenda: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/379 Stream: https://youtu.be/09z-yijllWA Zoom: to be shared here prior to the call Is there an RPC to get the checkpoints? We did need to add `--whitelist=10920274=0xfd652086d220d506ae5b7cb80fde97d2f3f7028d346cc7d9d384a83d3d638532` to some nodes to get them to progress otherwise they were getting a bad competing block from a lot of older peers
